NebulaGrid

Staff Software Engineer - Distributed AI
Based in Edinburgh, remote. £125k

NebulaGrid is developing infrastructure for the next generation of intelligent software, helping engineering teams build, deploy and coordinate autonomous services at scale. This role sits within our Distributed Intelligence division, responsible for building the orchestration layer that coordinates large populations of software agents.We are looking for engineers who enjoy working with emerging technologies and solving complex distributed-systems problems. Your day to day will involve designing and developing services capable of coordinating thousands of concurrent workloads. The principal technology stack is Python, Rust, Kubernetes & PostgreSQL.We’re interested in speaking to developers with at least six years of professional software engineering experience.
